items.title: FCC modifies foreign-produced power inverter Covered List entry
items.quote: FCC announced a modification of the power inverters entry on the Covered List and revised the scope of foreign-produced inverters subject to the restriction.

items.title: Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department FSIE guidance remains the governing published framework
items.quote: The published guidance describes the foreign-sourced income exemption regime and specified foreign income rules; it does not establish a nationwide 20% individual tax collection rule for Hong Kong savings insurance proceeds.

items.title: AIA reports Hong Kong new business value growth in 2026 interim results
items.quote: AIA Hong Kong new business value was reported at US$1.168 billion, up 10% year on year, while annualized new premiums were broadly unchanged.

items.title: Domestic procurement notice for国产 GPU servers used for large-model collaborative computing
items.quote: A public tender was issued for国产 GPU server procurement for a wide-area multi-computing-center large-model collaborative computing project, with a budget of RMB 4.321292 million and bid opening on 2026-09-15.

items.note: 截至 2026-08-28 到期日，当前文章材料记录科技板块反弹（科创板单日 +3.77%、中证500 +2.26%）以及中际旭创相关讨论，但没有可复核的结构化证据证明科技板块出现 30% 以上普跌或中际旭创跌至 700 元；因此该预判在本期无法确认或证伪。依据 article-pack 中 A-4b9c6e778c59、A-e2e3b75cdc29、A-9016bdd99826 等当期材料。
